newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Beijing North Star IPO says 397 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Beijing North Star IPO says 397 times subscribed.

text.p: Chinese property development and investment concern Beijing North Star Co Ltd said on Tuesday its initial public offering of 92.22 million H-shares at HK$2.40 each in Hong Kong was 397 times subscribed.
The offering initially involved a new issue of 92.22 H-shares and a placing of 522.58 million H-shares to raise about HK$1.48 billion.
North Star, the property arm of China's Beijing municipal government, said in a statement an additional 92.22 million had been reallocated from the placing to the new issue.

HSBC Investment Bank Asia Ltd, on behalf of the underwriters, had partially exercised the over-allotment option granted to it by North Star, and it had issued and alloted an additional 27.66 million H-shares to cover over subscriptions in the new issue, it said.
